items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I played in that band with Earl Hines and he put me down with Johnny Sincere

ctx.x: But they get mad if you move off that corner.

Yeah, but all the other banjo players will accidentally do it too, so they come back to you. You see, yeah, they fire you for that and they go hire this other guy. And eventually he come to that, then they fire him and get the other guy. And that's what it was. Charlie, all the banjos playing like that. It's like Johnny Brown had around him by practicing every banjo, even Johnny Sincere, he tell you that. He worked with him. With Johnny? Johnny Brown, all of them, every musician in the city had him work with that…
Did you have a piano ever much in those days?
